study type: Secondary analysis of a retrospective cohort study
outcome: Sterilization at the time of cesarean delivery
cohort: 481 women who desired sterilization at the time of cesarean delivery
finding: Women with Medicaid insurance were less likely to receive sterilization at the time of cesarean delivery compared to those with private insurance, primarily due to lack of valid consent forms and adhesive disease.
mod_finding: This study found that women with Medicaid insurance were less likely to receive a desired sterilization procedure at the time of cesarean delivery compared to women with private insurance.
